title: Control (library)
description: Something the company does, on purpose, to reduce likelihood or impact of a harm. The spine of the program. Compiled per program from shape + doctrine + the company's own inventory — never a bundled catalogue.

statement.description: What the company does. In its own words, not a framework's.

prevents.description: The intermediate harm(s) this control exists to prevent — the tree's upward edge. A control with none is a finding about the catalogue.

capability.description: The coverage expectation in a domain this control satisfies (e.g. 'anti-malware on endpoints').

domain.description: The control domain (e.g. identity-access, endpoint, vendor).

risk_note.description: The harm(s) this control exists to prevent, in harm-sentence form — the single field that converts a checklist into a risk catalogue.

origin.description: A compliance-origin control is marked so; it still earns its place by the harm it prevents.
